question: In a certain code language, if SUNSET is coded as 'TTOTDU' and MOONRISE is coded as 'NNNOSHTD', then what will STARS be coded as?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9468fc12fb235adbef69137e8ea31a64a381b1e107b34b6ed6af8d9477acd97.png] 

The logic followed here is:

SUNSET is coded as 'TTOTDU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/623789d72bcd738a79f7e6444ca94c6222b76a880c229931de7f46caf4601bbe.png] 

MOONRISE is coded as 'NNNOSHTD',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbf4134d9bfa36ec779e27592e55f4ac26c239a6d7704d3ea51caace283b27d0.png] 

Similarly, **STARS **will be coded:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4abd9d019eaf798ac696551510e6800d24ba33e0fd3775e7e237015643f8ccc1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**TUZST**".
